summary: The predecessor multi-node execution failed for a harness reason (receipt 4ed46b198c8d41618cc855df0a63d469: the elected leader was C, A had applied nothing, so A's snapshot was refused with 'nothing new to snapshot'). This revision of the same investigation's fixed experiment makes leadership deterministic by transferring it to A through the library's own LeadershipTransferToServer, commits a command through A and waits until A's FSM has applied it before snapshotting, and shuts all nodes down on every exit path so no goroutine logs after the test returns. Four local construction runs of the revised harness reproduced the intended witness (A tracking the snapshot's three-voter configuration while its log's committed configuration has two, applying 'stale-quorum-entry' with apply_error nil, B's log without the entry and C's log holding it at the same term); the retained execution is requested again, with the three harness changes recorded in semantic_changes and the failed receipt retained as an explained harness failure.
